data.body:
Change pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/3119 (`b6e723ceb5975dcf3693477c6478ad8b4ff0d990`, hashtag `rebar-session-c657653d`).

Local verification before push:
- `make verify` exits 0 — 19,808 passed, 88 skipped, 0 failed (52m31s).
- `pytest tests/unit/test_codex_agent_guidance.py -q` → 2 passed.
- `grep -c "recent merged Gerrit history" AGENTS.md` → 0; `grep -c "feature-branch-driver" AGENTS.md` → 0.
- 108 AGENTS.md-adjacent guard tests pass, including `test_client_template_sync.py` (checked because AGENTS.md feeds a client template).

Note on the first `make verify` run: it failed with 17 reconciler wiki-render failures that were **not** caused by this change — a clean tree at the same base `6a0e3c9afcd` failed identically. Root cause was `pypandoc_binary` 1.17 shipping an x86_64 pandoc inside its arm64 macOS wheel, with Rosetta non-functional on this host. Filed as bug `degraded-chilly-galago` (`bb19-4776-46d2-4223`), linked `discovered_from` this ticket. Installing the official native `pandoc-3.9-arm64-macOS` build (same pinned version) over the wheel's binary turned all 17 green; the second `make verify` run is the clean one cited above.

Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1` before Submit.
